_comment: Settings for issue_report.py and the triage package. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored. Pass --config to use another file.

episodes._comment: An episode is a stretch of consecutive failing steps, reported as one finding.
episodes._max_pass_gap_note: Passing steps allowed inside an episode before it ends. Failures that flicker stay one episode.
episodes._blip_max_steps_note: An unnamed episode that recovered by itself and lasted at most this many steps is a blip (listed in a table, not as a card).
episodes._repro_window_note: Number of actions up to and including the first failing step shown as the reproduction recipe.

log_markers._comment: Wording the mutation loop writes into step descriptions. Update these if the log messages change.

invariants._comment: Plain-language statement of what must always hold. Rules not listed here use the name from the log.
invariants.INV-S0: The schema held by the editor is always a valid JSON object
invariants.INV-S3: The title shown in the Schema panel matches the schema MetaConfigurator holds internally
invariants.INV-D1: The Data Text View parses to exactly the same object as the editor's internal data
invariants.INV-D3: The GUI's required-field stars match the schema's required list
invariants.INV-D4: Every GUI row has a matching data key, and no stale values are left in the GUI
invariants.INV-D5: String values shown in the GUI match the data
invariants.INV-D6: The GUI's validation icons match the schema violations in the data
invariants.INV-S1: The Schema Text View parses to exactly the same object as the editor's internal schema
invariants.INV-S2: Every top-level schema key has a visible row in the Schema GUI
invariants.INV-GUI-ERR-01: A validation error shown in the Text View is also shown by the GUI View's error indicator

retired_invariants._comment: Episodes that fail only these invariants are filtered out.
retired_invariants.INV-D2: Retired: replaced by temporal invariant TEMP-ADD-03

known_bugs.summary: Undo leaves an orphaned row across Text View and GUI View
The 'any'-typed fallback widget does not show the validation-error icon

caveats.undo_redo_across_panels: This sequence uses Undo/Redo and touches both panels. Undo stacks are per panel (Data and Schema), so first check that the Undo was pressed in the same panel as the edit; otherwise the failure may not be an app bug.

screenshots._comment: Screenshots are named step_<N>_<action>.png. N counts the main actions; the tool's own undo/retry screenshots share the N of the action that triggered them. Files are matched by N and action name. They are looked up in the run's folder, one level below it, and <root>/<run_id>.
screenshots._max_width_px_note: With Pillow installed, images are shrunk to this width and saved as JPEG. 0 embeds the originals.

state_snapshots._comment: Full before/after app state for a step where an invariant failed. Written by mutation_loop's export_history() for every failing step of a live run and by replay_runner for a replay. A card shows the diff when files for its run_id are found here. Otherwise it suggests: python -m tests.mutation_testing.replay_runner --history <history.json>
state_snapshots._root_note: Files are <root>/<run_id>/step_<N>_before.json and step_<N>_after.json, where N is the 0-based position in the history's 'steps' list.

project._comment: Used in the drafted GitHub issue text and the 'Start here' box.

invariant_details._comment: Optional 'look_for': what is visible on screen when the rule is broken. Rules without an entry get a generic sentence.

INV-D1.look_for: The Data Text View shows different content than the GUI View shows for the same data.

INV-S1.look_for: The Schema Text View shows different content than the Schema GUI shows for the same schema.

INV-D3.look_for: A field's required star is missing in the GUI, or shown on a field that is not required.

INV-D5.look_for: A text field in the GUI shows a different value than the data contains.

INV-D6.look_for: A field shows a validation-error icon it should not have, or lacks one it should have.

INV-S2.look_for: A top-level schema key (such as properties or required) has no row in the Schema GUI.

INV-S3.look_for: The title field in the Schema panel and the "title" in the schema's Text View show different values.

INV-D4.look_for: The GUI shows a row with content that has no matching key in the data (an orphaned row), or a data key has no row.

INV-GUI-ERR-01.look_for: The Text View marks a validation error, but the GUI View shows no error icon for that field.

time_filter._comment: How run start times are read for --since and --until: meta.resolved_settings.run_id, then the history file's folder name, then the file's modified time.

defaults._comment: Used when no folder is given.

log_excerpt._comment: Rows shown around the first failing action.

episode_sequence._comment: Maximum rows in 'What happened during this failure'.

causal._comment: Settings for causal_analysis.py (the 'Where it likely started' section).
causal._transition_rule_prefixes_note: Rules whose id starts with one of these compare the state before and after a single action, so the failing action itself is the lead. Add NEW- here if NEW-xx rules behave the same way.

rule_reads._comment: Which state facets each rule reads, so the report only suspects actions that changed one of them. Facets: de_data, de_schema, se_schema, se_data, de_text, se_text. For rules not listed, any state change makes an action a suspect.

issue_report._comment: Settings for issue_report.py (the short list of distinct problems).
issue_report._inferred_rule_prefixes_note: Rules mined automatically from recorded runs. A problem found only by such rules is tagged 'inferred rule' and sorted last, because the rule itself may be wrong.

short_names.INV-D1: Data Text View differs from the internal data
short_names.INV-D3: Required-field stars in the GUI are wrong
short_names.INV-D4: GUI rows do not match the data (orphaned or missing row)
short_names.INV-D5: String values in the GUI differ from the data
short_names.INV-D6: Validation icons in the GUI are wrong
short_names.INV-S0: The schema is no longer a valid object
short_names.INV-S1: Schema Text View differs from the internal schema
short_names.INV-S2: A top-level schema key has no GUI row
short_names.INV-S3: Schema title field differs from the internal schema
short_names.INV-GUI-ERR-01: Text View shows a validation error the GUI does not
short_names.TEMP-ADD-03: Adding a required item does not reach the data

run_logs._comment: The mutation loop's own log files: <root>/<folder or file whose name contains the run id>, also looked up next to mutation_history. The root must be 'mutation_logs' (plural), matching mutation_logs/<run_id>/mutation_log.html.
